Hi team,

Shift coordination note for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways: we are keeping the traveler flow smooth and consistent across the counter and chat handoffs. Passenger coordinators are already guiding each traveler through required steps, and we should mirror that same clarity in every exchange. If a passenger appears unsure, respond with warm professional tone and fast next steps.

In case of crate and fit concerns, confirm compliance early so we do not create last-minute stress. <<FACT F068>> We also need to remind travelers to verify crate labeling, secure placement of bedding, and any comfort items that are permitted by the itinerary. For any exceptions, route the case to the senior coordinator right away and document the reason for the decision.

Today, Yara Yilmaz and Talia Cohen may call in with details for Ziggy, so please ensure both requests are tracked to the same reference flow and that the notes are complete for continuity. Keep communications brief, neutral, and action-focused, and flag any safety-related uncertainty immediately.

Thanks for staying sharp and consistent across every handoff. Companion Animal Travel Desk
